Health Functional FoodMagnesium 400mgVitamin B1 1.21mgVitamin B12 2.4μgVitamin B2 1.44mgVitamin B6 1.57mgOnce a day

마그네슘 400 액티브Magnesium · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6

Made by (주)씨이에스팜 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 400mg of Magnesium, 1.21mg of Vitamin B1, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.44mg of Vitamin B2, 1.57mg of Vitamin B6 as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 400mg Magnesium, 1.21mg Vitamin B1, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.44mg Vitamin B2, 1.57mg Vitamin B6
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)씨이에스팜

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Magnesium
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Magnesium labelled (400mg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (1.21mg / 1200mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (2.4μg / 1200mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.44mg / 1200mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.57mg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 점박이가 있는 하양색의 장방형 정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 습기가 적고 직사광선을 받지 않는 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오. 영·유아 및 어린이의 손에 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Magnesium · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
